description: Under full semantics, the minimum formula for the assigned binary relation \(R\) holds exactly when every nonempty subset of the domain has an element with no \(R\)-predecessor in that subset.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.fullRealize_wellOrderFormula.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {M : Type w} [L.Structure M] (R : ℕ) (a : ℕ → M)
  (r : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.RelationAssignment M) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.fullRealize a r
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.wellOrderFormula R) ↔
    ∀ (S : Set M), S.Nonempty → ∃ m ∈ S, ∀ x ∈ S, ¬r 2 R ![x, m]
